from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLiability(BaseModel):
    """A single financial liability line item extracted from a company filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the company the filing belongs to")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the line item (e.g., 'Accounts Payable')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value reported for this item")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the currency (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands')")
    reporting_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date associated with this figure")
    statement_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial statement containing this item")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    liabilities: list[FinancialLiability]
